description: Editable canonical field dictionary for heterogeneous literature-extraction records. Add aliases, fields, context keys or plausible ranges here; no code change is needed. Versions: bump schema_version when canonical fields change and record the migration in references/types-and-migration.md.

fields.name: record_id
fields.label: Extraction record identifier
fields.description: Identifier assigned by the extractor to a single row. Never auto-generated from row content.

fields.name: doi
fields.label: Source document DOI
fields.description: Digital object identifier of the source paper; part of the duplicate context key.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Source document title
fields.description: Source paper title; used as context only, never merged across different DOIs.

fields.name: locator
fields.label: Evidence locator inside the source document

fields.name: material
fields.label: Material / catalyst / sample name
fields.description: Named entity the measurement belongs to. Different names are never silently unified.

fields.name: property
fields.label: Measured property / metric name
fields.description: Free-text metric label used when the extraction table is in long format.

fields.name: temperature
fields.label: Reaction / measurement temperature
fields.description: Temperatures are normalized to K only when an explicit unit is present; no silent °C/K assumption.

fields.name: pressure
fields.label: Reaction / measurement pressure
fields.description: Normalized to MPa when the unit is known.

fields.name: reaction_time
fields.label: Reaction / residence time
fields.description: Normalized to hours when the unit is known.

fields.name: yield
fields.label: Product yield
fields.description: Percent quantity; ranges are kept as low/high endpoints, no midpoint is invented.

fields.name: energy
fields.label: Energy quantity (barrier, activation energy)
fields.description: Normalized to kJ/mol; eV is converted with the documented per-particle to per-mole factor 96.485.
